_README: Auto repair broker source registry. Mirrors the veterinary TVM/dental TDPM broker_codes.json pattern. site_prefix TASM = The Auto Shop Market (feeds theautoshopmarket.com). NEVER collides with TDPM- (dental), TVM- (veterinary), or any other vertical's prefix. 'ref_prefix' is the source-scoped broker reference shown muted on cards. 'aggregator: true' sources are treated like the network's blocked aggregators and purged by the normalizer. Every source here is a real broker's own site (a national/regional brokerage's own domain, or an independently-owned regional franchise office's own domain) — never an aggregator/marketplace.

sunbeltsfl.broker_name: Sunbelt Business Brokers of South Florida

_note_on_sunbeltnetwork: sunbeltnetwork.com (the Sunbelt corporate umbrella search site, distinct from each independently-owned regional office's own domain like sunbeltatlanta.com / sunbeltsfl.com) returns HTTP 403 to a polite scraper fetch (Cloudflare) and is not used as a source. Regional Sunbelt office domains ARE each office's own site and are used.
